rules.name: SQL Injection Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in HTTP requests including UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, and comment-based injection
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
input_validation_events
| where input_validation has_any("wstg", "input-validation", "sql-injection", "injection")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
